newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Investor gives no comment on Electrolux.
newsitem.headline: Investor gives no comment on Electrolux.

text.p: Swedish investment company Investor AB on Tuesday declined comment on a newspaper report that the Wallenberg business empire could sell its stake in household appliance group Electrolux AB.

The French newspaper La Tribune said the Wallenbergs, who control a large chunk of Swedish industries through its investment vehicle Investor, was said to be in talks with South Korean company Daewoo Electronics.
"Out of principle, we cannot confirm or deny this," Nils Ingvar Lundin, Investor spokesman, told Reuters.

La Tribune said according to its sources, the Wallenberg family has decided to sell its stake of Electrolux, the world's leading supplier of houshold appliance, in which it holds the majority of voting stock.
The paper said none of the parties concerned had wanted to comment on the reports.
